```python
import json

# 输入数据
performance_data = json.loads('{"high_quality_reps": 7, "error_reps": 3, "most_frequent_error_type": "下蹲深度不足"}')
communication_result = "想挑战更严格标准"
user_training_demand = "塑形"
exercise_name = "深蹲"
rep_count = 10
quality_standard_config = json.loads('{"squat_depth": {"is_enabled": True, "standard": "medium"}}')

# 决策逻辑
high_quality_ratio = performance_data['high_quality_reps'] / rep_count
error_rate = performance_data['error_reps'] / rep_count

# 初始化调整建议
adjustment_suggestion = {
    "should_adjust": False,
    "reason": ""
}

# 评估训练表现
if high_quality_ratio < 0.5 and error_rate > 0:
    adjustment_suggestion['should_adjust'] = True
    if communication_result == "想挑战更严格标准":
        adjustment_suggestion['adjustment'] = {
            "type": "CHANGE_QUALITY_STANDARD",
            "checkpoint_Id": "squat_depth",
            "old_standard": quality_standard_config['squat_depth']['standard'],
            "new_standard": "high",
            "adjust_reason": "提高标准以满足挑战需求"
        }
    else:
        adjustment_suggestion['adjustment'] = {
            "type": "CHANGE_REP_COUNT",
            "old_Reps": rep_count,
            "new_Reps": max(5, rep_count - 2),  # 保证至少有5个重复次数
            "adjust_reason": "降低重复次数以减少错误"
}

# 如果高质量重复比例大于80%，通常不调整
elif high_quality_ratio > 0.8 and error_rate < 0.2:
    adjustment_suggestion['reason'] = "训练表现良好，无需调整"

# 结合沟通结果与用户诉求
if communication_result == "感觉太累":
    adjustment_suggestion['should_adjust'] = True
    adjustment_suggestion['adjustment'] = {
        "type": "CHANGE_REP_COUNT",
        "old_Reps": rep_count,
        "new_Reps": rep_count - 2,
        "adjust_reason": "用户疲劳，减少重复次数"
    }

# 检查质量评价点
if performance_data['most_frequent_error_type'] == '下蹲深度不足':
    adjustment_suggestion['should_adjust'] = True
    adjustment_suggestion['adjustment'] = {
        "type": "CHANGE_QUALITY_STANDARD",
        "checkpoint_Id": "squat_depth",
        "old_standard": quality_standard_config['squat_depth']['standard'],
        "new_standard": "high",
        "adjust_reason": "常见错误，提高质量标准"
    }

# 输出调整建议
print(json.dumps(adjustment_suggestion, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
```
